## About this collection

This section will grow into a collection of course pages, lecture notes, practical tutorials, workshop materials, and mentoring resources.

Materials will emphasize clear explanations, reproducible examples, and connections between statistical concepts and real applications.

## Planned materials

- Courses and lesson notes
- Workshops and step-by-step tutorials
- Examples, exercises, and assignments
- Student-project and research mentoring resources
